questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: a different culture but still relatively close to home. offered lots of available spots and some of my friends went as well

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: it was good but still overwhelming I was fortunate to have classmates from home in Milan as well, so we could help each other

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: just information on e mail and then we could go to the international office for further assistance

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: I would have liked better introduction to the campus and the different locations. it was difficult to navigate the different campuses and finding the classrooms

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: it was okay, we used spot a home

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: there are good options but I recommend booking through an agency as we experienced problems with the appliances in the apartment

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: the course registration was bit difficult and took a long time. I would have liked some more guidance or introduction to the system

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: for what it's worth know we could contact the international office and the relevant professors through e mail

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: end the end I got good and somewhat relevant classes. I had no trouble with being accepted and there were enough spots available in my desired classes

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: use a lot of time to learn the websites they use such as Ariel, unimia and so on

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I took mostly MA classes and found that the level of education was a bit easier than I expected but I worked well with the fact that I was a the last semester of my BA

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: very different and a completely different relationship between the professor and the students

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.answer:

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: they were all good

Additional comments:

questions.answer: I don't know

questions.answer: didn't use it

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: good opportunities for exploring other part of Italy. but also lot to do in Milan visit the different neighbourhoods

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: good with a better English level among the locals than expected

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: not too much only in certain courses for group work and so on. if you want to meet locals, try and pick the smaller courses

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: the education system and the relationship between the students and the professors. I found it less accepted to questions the lectures and ways of teaching

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: it is a big city so I met mostly international people. I think for more cultural or local experiences go to the smaller cities

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
it will take a few weeks to get adjusted and create a routine 
the professors offer good guidance in terms of exams and so on
make sure the professors know you're and Erasmus student

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: there is good flexibility with deciding courses, so don't be afraid to change. be aware of attending/non attending courses and decide what you want to do

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: meeting new people

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: building a routine

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
